family_definition.title: the spatial nonuniformity of density
family_definition.finding_goal: Characterize the spatial nonuniformity of density
family_definition.scope: the supplied turbulent radiative mixing-layer snapshot

questions.o1_f1: In the supplied turbulent radiative mixing-layer snapshot, consider the complete supplied three-dimensional mesh. Investigate the spatial nonuniformity of density. Use all cells, with stored cell values directly and arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Use the volume-weighted standard deviation divided by the absolute volume-weighted mean. Weight cell statistics by cell volume and normalize by the included volume. Report the numerical coefficient.

Choose and explain the remaining quantitative definition. Report the numerical coefficient.
